name: farm-oh
title: Ohio farm property and liability rating
summary: Rate one insurer's farmowners program in Ohio from the manual it filed: county zones, dwelling and outbuilding premiums, farm personal property, farm liability, deductibles, package rules and the manual's stale pages.
description: Each task gives the AI the farm property and liability manual one insurer filed in Ohio, with the filing's actuarial memorandum, and states the facts in the question, such as a dwelling's county and its amount of insurance. It asks for exact values: a zone, a credit, a premium, a rule, or the errors in the manual itself. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Zones and territory
families.what: A county's zone after the territory change, mine subsidence by county, and rates that depend on the county.

families.name: Dwelling rating
families.what: Dwelling types and the construction, protection and age credits, applied in the manual's order.

families.name: Dwelling and contents tables
families.what: Dwelling and contents premiums read from the zone tables, with interpolation, add-ons, rounding and optional coverages.

families.name: Outbuildings and farm property
families.what: Outbuilding, special type and farm personal property premiums, blanket or scheduled, with their credits and minimums.

families.name: Farm liability
families.what: Liability premiums by acreage, employees, residences, incidental business and higher limits.

families.name: Deductibles
families.what: Deductible factors and minimums, and what a deductible leaves alone.

families.name: Size of premium credit
families.what: The size of premium credit tier at its boundaries, and the coverages it leaves out.

families.name: Package rules
families.what: What the package includes, its rates and required sections, account credits, minimums and program tiers.

families.name: Eligibility
families.what: Whether a dwelling, outbuilding or endorsement is eligible, and on what conditions.

families.name: Checking the manual
families.what: The manual's stale pages and inconsistencies, told apart from passages that are right.
